newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: General Electric expands Singapore office.
newsitem.headline: General Electric expands Singapore office.

text.p: General Electric Company said on Wednesday its subsidiary GE Pacific Pte Ltd (GE) will expand its regional operation base in Singapore.
A company statement said the move follows an extension of its operational headquarters status (OHQ) by the Economic Development Board (EDB).
An OHQ status gives the U.S. company certain incentives including tax breaks.
GE will extend the role of Singapore as a center of its high technology, manufacturing and service businesses in the Asia-Pacific region.
Singapore will also serve as the Southeast Asia base for GE International Inc, the company's corporate management component.
The company's regional training, telecommunications and treasury functions will also be expanded in Singapore.

"GE has been active in Southeast Asia for more than 100 years. Today the Asean region is a US$3.4 billion market for GE in which the company employs nearly 9000 people," said Ken Brown, president of GE Southeast Asia in the statement.
